reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Log messages across cert-manager have been augmented with better contextual structured data", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Log lines now include more structured contextual data; anything matching on literal log strings may stop matching.

proposed.statement: cert-manager log messages now carry richer structured contextual data, so consumers matching on literal log-line strings may break.
